mapper.sql: SELECT s.*, q.title AS question_title, uf.username AS from_username, ut.username AS to_username FROM share s LEFT JOIN question q ON q.id = s.question_id LEFT JOIN user uf ON uf.id = s.from_user_id LEFT JOIN user ut ON ut.id = s.to_user_id
mapper.select: WHERE s.from_user_id = #{fromUserId} ORDER BY s.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM share WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND share_type = 2 AND from_user_id = #{fromUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO share (question_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, share_type, message) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{shareType}, #{message})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM share WHERE id = #{id} AND from_user_id = #{fromUserId}
DELETE FROM share WHERE question_id IN #{id}
